coverage: Audited bank group results · four operating segments and group adjustments
definition: The company’s reported segment result after taking account of operating costs and possible loan losses, but before income tax.
sourceLabel: Audited annual bank and segment results
location: Signed April 18 NSE report, consolidated audited financial results and consolidated segment reporting, 31 March 2026 annual column.
notes: The group reports ₹36,921.38 crore across the four segments and unassigned income, plus a positive inter-segment adjustment of ₹371.37 crore, giving ₹37,292.75 crore in group total income. The group earned ₹4,643.42 crore before tax and ₹3,512.05 crore after tax before deducting the share that belongs to minority owners of controlled companies. Profit after tax attributable to YES BANK shareholders was ₹3,511.71 crore.
insight: Corporate Banking and Treasury earned positive reported results. Retail Banking brought in the highest segment income but had a negative segment result.
revenueTotalLabel: Total segment income before the inter-segment adjustment
incomeDefinition: Gross interest earned from loans and investments plus fees and other income, before funding costs, operating bills and expected loan losses.
